name: superpowers-flow
description: Live progress for superpowers plan runs: a bar above the prompt with a session row (turn, speed, cost, cache, context), an agents panel with model, steps, context, cost and time, and five tiered sp-* workers (Fable / Opus at set efforts) that superpowers dispatches instead of general-purpose. Adapted from savvy-flow and savvy-progress.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

notify.title: Push notifications
notify.description: off: none; milestones: a notification (or a toast) when a task is accepted, a worker fails, or the run finishes. Reaches the phone over Remote Control when Push when Claude decides is on in /config.

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: tier: when an sp-* worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts
